questions.text: The average annual growth rate in Net Sales for the industry from 1995 onwards was 20%. By how many EUR did the Net Sales of IPG exceed the industry average by 1997?
questions.explanation: Start from 1,600 in 1995 and grow 20% a year: 1996 = 1,920; 1997 = 2,304. IPG 1997 = 2,568, so it exceeds by 264m — not an option.

questions.text: What was the average annual percentage growth in Net Sales for 1999 and 2000?

flag.note: The PDF only computes 2000's growth (and 201 ÷ 2,508 is actually 8.0%). The question asks for the average over 1999 and 2000: 1999 growth = (2,508 − 2,375) ÷ 2,375 = 5.6%; 2000 growth = 8.0%; average = 6.8% (D). PDF working: (2,709 − 2,508) ÷ 2,508 = 7.9% (2000 only).

questions.text: If 90% of cars in Argentina are owned by urban dwellers, what percentage of urban dwellers own cars (assuming a maximum of one car per person)?
questions.explanation: Cars owned by urban dwellers = 90% × 4.1m = 3.69m. Urban population = 86.4% × 35.6m = 30.76m. 3.69 ÷ 30.76 = 12%.

What was the percentage decrease in the cost of mining from 2007 to 2008?
In 2009 an additional £100,000 will be spent on exploration. If total annual expenditure increases by 8%, what proportion of overall expenditure will exploration account for?

flag.note: Ambiguous; two readings. The key's reading: exploration keeps its 29% share of the 8%-larger total and then gets an extra £100,000: (0.29 × 4,320,000 + 100,000) ÷ 4,320,000 = 31.31% (B). The plain reading: 2009 exploration = 2008 exploration + £100,000: (1,160,000 + 100,000) ÷ 4,320,000 = 29.2%, which matches no option exactly (A is 29.7%). The site keeps the key, B.

If the percentage increase in production of vehicles by Ford between 2007 and 2008 were repeated annually how many years would it be before Ford produced at least 5,800,000 vehicles in the UK?

flag.note: The question says 5,800,000, but the chart is in thousands; the PDF's working uses 58,000. With 58,000 the answer is 4 years (B). Read literally, 5,800,000 would take about 33 years.

questions.text: The average distance flown per passenger departing within Europe 5 years ago was 1,000km. Today this figure has decreased by 20%. By how many percent has the total distance travelled by flights departing in Europe changed today?
questions.explanation: 5 years ago: 0.3bn passengers × 1,000 km = 300bn km. Today: 0.9bn × 800 km = 720bn km. (720 − 300) ÷ 300 = +140%.

questions.text: In millions of US$, what was the average (mean) amount donated by the six largest donors of the OECD Development Assistance Committee?
Which of these six countries donated the most per capita?
questions.explanation: Aid ÷ population: Norway 2,042 ÷ 4.6 = 444 — far above the rest (UK 111, Canada 80, US 76, NZ 45).
